KAFKA-9033.title: Change default client-id in consumer / producer to be more meaningful
KAFKA-9033.description:
Right now in consumer / producer, the default client-id is set as {{consumer-[suffix]}} and {{producer-[suffix]}} which is not very meaningful; on the other hand, since client-ids will be shown on the broker request logs it can be very useful for debugging purposes.

So I'd propose we change their default values as the following:

1. For producer:

{{producer-[transactionalId]-[suffix]}} where {{transactionalId}} would be set to {{none}} if null.

2. For consumer:

{{consumer-[groupId]-[instanceId or suffix]}} where {{groupId}} would be set to {{none}} if null, and {{suffix}} would only be used if {{instanceId}} is set to null.

commits.message: KAFKA-9033; Use consumer/producer identity in generated clientId
commits.author: hachikuji

KAFKA-9110.title: Improve efficiency of disk reads when TLS is enabled
KAFKA-9110.description:
We currently do 8k reads and do unnecessary copies and allocations in every read. Increasing the read size is particularly helpful for magnetic disks and avoiding the copies and allocations improves CPU efficiency.

See the pull request for more details:

[https://github.com/apache/kafka/pull/7604]
